duas.title: Protection from Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.title: Ayatul Kursi
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm
duas.translation: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.

duas.title: Protection from Satan
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah, the All-Hearing, All-Knowing, from the accursed Satan.

duas.title: Surah Al-Falaq
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi-Rabbil-falaq, min sharri ma khalaq, wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab
duas.translation: Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, and from the evil of darkness when it settles.

duas.title: Protection from Harm
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala'i wa darakish-shaqa'i wa su'il-qada'i wa shamatil-a'da'
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from severe calamity, from misery to fall upon me, from a bad fate, and from the gloating of enemies.

duas.title: Seeking Refuge in All Affairs
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqri wa 'adhabil-qabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave.
